'''Nicole''' (Japanese: '''ノリコ''' ''Noriko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG012|The Lotad Lowdown]]''. She has two sisters, [[Natalie]] and {{OBP|Rita|AG012}}, who, together, run the [[Pretty Petal flower shop]] located near a lake full of {{p|Lotad}}.

After lecturing Natalie, her younger sister, about being nice to travelers, Nicole offered {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to stay over for lunch and sample the [[Oran Berry]] pie that she baked. While eating, Nicole, along with her sister Rita, invited the gang to view the flower shop's garden to see all sorts of {{Berries}} they were growing. While touring the garden, Ash took interest in the [[Tamato Berry]], but Nicole quickly stopped him from eating it due to its severe spiciness.

Nicole is very knowledgeable when it comes to Berries and their effects.
